title: Verify multi-client gameplay, reconnect and silent spectator authority
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Use independent browser identities against the approved emulator service. Create directory-visible and passcode lobbies, join with duplicate aliases/distinct avatars, ready/start and complete canonical gameplay. Include reconnect, a stale intent, a lost response, deadline fallback, S2 sealed voting and S4/S5 Disconnect/Null outcomes. Compare authoritative projections with the displayed public phase without using another player's private input as a test oracle. Exercise public/private-code and passcode entry without publishing passcodes or roles in artifacts.
acceptance: Browser contexts converge on the same revision/public board while each receives only permitted private fields.
Expired, duplicate and stale intents cannot mutate the wrong phase or grant membership from a local hint.
Game-Disconnected players become permanent silent spectators without Crew, vote, chat or private-diagnostic access.
The match completes legally, resources are cleaned up and artifacts sanitized, without deploying live cloud services.
